messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — SEV2: eu-prod embeddings queue latency spike. Metrics: ingress 520r/s, p50 120ms -> 2.1s, 5xx ~5% over last 3m. Alert ID: ABC123. PagerDuty: https://pd.internal/redwood/alerts/ABC123

Priya K: acked — taking this. I’m on-call and looking at eu-prod now.

Jordan L: thanks Priya. ping me if you need extra hands. any initial customer signals? :eyes:

Priya K: quick update — spike began ~09:12 UTC, correlates with a small rollout to dedicated pool-3. Seeing repeated OOM-ish traces in inference-worker logs and heavy KV cache evictions. Pulling pod logs and node metrics now.

Carlos M: if pool-3 is flapping we should consider draining it and shifting traffic to pool-1. I can stand up extra capacity on pool-1 if needed.

Priya K: running drain on gpu-node-23 in pool-3: `kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will let k8s reschedule. Also applying request-route fallback to smaller model for embed route.

pagerduty-bot: Note — auto-escalation scheduled in 5m if there is no ownership change.

Priya K: applying degraded-mode route: `POST /internal/routes/update {"route":"/embed","fallback_model":"redwood-mini-8q"}` — this will keep p50 < 500ms for degraded traffic. Executed.

Jordan L: copy. Posting the command here for CS: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' -d '{"route":"embed","fallback_model":"redwood-mini-8q"}'`

Priya K: customer impact estimate: ~8% of embed requests affected during peak window. 3 customers flagged support tickets about slow retrievals. No data corruption. Notifying CSMs now.

Carlos M: looking at recent commit history — `feat/kv-tuning` changed cache-size default; evictions spiked at 09:12. Rolling back that commit to staging and preparing prod rollback if revert reduces evictions.

Priya K: confirmed rollback to staging; prepping prod rollback if metrics don’t improve in next 8m.

pagerduty-bot: PD: escalation suppressed (ack present).

Priya K: rollback applied to prod (reverted `feat/kv-tuning`). Watching.

Priya K: metrics check: errors dropping — 5xx down to 0.7%, p50 stabilized at ~140ms. Starting undrain of gpu-node-23.

Carlos M: taking over post-incident duties — will collect traces, heap profiles, and config diffs for the postmortem. Priya, could you transfer PD ownership to me?

Priya K: transferring PD ownership to Carlos M now. Done.

Jordan L: thanks everyone. I’ll draft a short sticky note for CS and ops with timelines and customer list.

incident-bot: PD alert ABC123 marked resolved by Carlos M at 09:42 UTC. Please file postmortem in #postmortems when ready.

Carlos M: will open the postmortem and ping here when initial draft is ready. Closing this thread unless new regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
